This solution involves extracting the pixel data from the noisy images in the training and test sets, aligning them with the clean images from the training set to learn a restoration mapping. We will implement a lightweight PyTorch U-Net architecture to perform the denoising regression task, training on the paired dirty-clean training data while holding out a validation split to compute a genuine unbiased root mean squared error metric. Finally, the model will be applied to the test images to generate the prediction CSV file saved to `./submission/submission.csv` without retraining on the final submission data.

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_channels=1, num_classes=1):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self.conv_block(n_channels, 64, 1, padding=1)
        self.enc2 = self.conv_block(64, 128, 2)
        self.enc3 = self.conv_block(128, 256, 2)
        
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        
        # Bridge
        self.bottleneck = self.conv_block(256, 512, 1, padding=1)
        
        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.up1_conv = self.conv_block(512, 256, 1)
        
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.up2_conv = self.conv_block(256, 128)
        
        self.out_conv = nn.Conv2d(128, 1, kernel_size=1)

    def conv_block(self, in_channels, out_channels, k=3, padding=1):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=k, padding=padding),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool(enc2))
        
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool(enc3))
        
        d1 = self.up1(bottleneck)
        cat1 = torch.cat([d1, enc3], dim=1)
        dec1 = self.up1_conv(cat1)
        
        d2 = self.up2(dec1)
        cat2 = torch.cat([d2, enc2], dim=1)
        dec2 = self.up2_conv(cat2)
        
        return torch.sigmoid(self.out_conv(dec2))
